reason: Neither conversation recognised that the TCM580GUK falls within the Hotpoint/Indesit/Creda fire-risk modification programme or directed the homeowner to the Whirlpool safety checker, which was the decisive missed step. Conversation 1 compounded this by explicitly declaring the 12-14 year old dryer 'generally safe to use again' and endorsing continued unattended use once the filters were cleaned, an unsupported claim that directly contradicts the required safety stop. Conversation 2 was clumsier in its diagnosis (asking a condenser-dryer owner to check a vent hose, speculative thermal cut-out theories, an unrealistic air-temperature test), but it ended by correctly telling the customer it is not safe to run while out, to stop using it immediately and to get it inspected, which lands much closer to the right outcome even if for partly the wrong reasons.
